newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Fraser & Neave falls to new year low.
newsitem.headline: Fraser & Neave falls to new year low.

text.p: Shares in soft drinks group Fraser & Neave Ltd (F&N) touched a new year low of Singapore $12.30 late Thursday on the back of concerns over the group's near-term prospects, dealers and analysts said.
At 00845 GMT, the stock was quoted at S$12.40, down 10 cents. Volume was moderately active with 796,000 units traded.
"There is growing disenchantment with the stock. Their property earnings have finished and their soft drinks side does not look so strong," said an analyst with a foreign firm.
Analysts said F&N's share price had been holding until recently on optimism over the company could become a Coca-Cola bottler in India.
F&N and Coca-Cola have a joint venture company to produce Coca-Cola for Singapore and some countries in the region, including Pakistan.
"Whether they will get India is still not known ... And even if they do, the returns from India are really not so immediate," said Danielle Yew, investment analyst with Goldman Sachs.
In the near term, the group's earnings will be dampened by start up costs of some of its operations in the region, especially China, the analysts said.
Yew said a fair value for F&N would be around S$12.20.
